trajectory_summary: This is not a sales call — a solar-owning customer called in out of technical curiosity about Tesla's roof-tile product, and the rep never had a real qualification or booking opportunity. The call leaked energy as the rep got pulled into unscoped technical debate (panel wattage, efficiency %) with no anchor point to redirect to a specialist or close the call. It ended amicably with no appointment need on either side.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag unknown, but this should not be scored as a missed booking failure — the customer had no buying intent and volunteered this at 00:28; the correct read is a curiosity/orphaned-lead call with no appointment to be had.
